using the deterministic agronomy engine.

        env_file=(".env",),
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        case_sensitive=False,
        extra="ignore",
    )

    # --- Application ------------------------------------------------------

    nasa_power_base_url: str = "https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal"
    nasa_power_community: str = "AG"
    nasa_power_timeout_seconds: float = Field(30.0, gt=0)
    nasa_power_cache_ttl_seconds: int = Field(3600, ge=0)
    nasa_power_daily_cache_ttl_seconds: int = Field(1800, ge=0)
    nasa_power_max_retries: int = Field(2, ge=0, le=5)
    nasa_power_retry_backoff_seconds: float = Field(0.75, ge=0)

    # --- AI ---------------------------------------------------------------
    ai_provider: str = "heuristic"
    ai_api_key: str | None = None
    ai_model: str | None = None
    ai_base_url: str | None = None
    ai_timeout_seconds: float = Field(45.0, gt=0)
    ai_temperature: float = Field(0.2, ge=0, le=2)
    ai_max_output_tokens: int = Field(1600, ge=256, le=8192)
    ai_weight: float = Field(0.35, ge=0, le=1)
    ai_fallback_to_heuristic: bool = True
    ai_json_mode: bool = True
    max_ai_candidates: int = Field(8, ge=1, le=16)

    @property
    def cors_origin_list(self) -> list[str]:
        raw = (self.cors_origins or "").strip()
        if raw in {"", "*"}:
            return ["*"]
        return [item.strip() for item in raw.split(",") if item.strip()]

    @property
    def normalized_ai_provider(self) -> str:
        return (self.ai_provider or "heuristic").strip().lower()


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    return Settings()

    handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)

    )

"""Pydantic request/response models (the public API contract)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Enumerations
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class SoilTexture(str, Enum):
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"
    SAND = "sand"
    LOAMY_SAND = "loamy_sand"
    SANDY_LOAM = "sandy_loam"
    LOAM = "loam"
    SILT_LOAM = "silt_loam"
    SILT = "silt"
    CLAY_LOAM = "clay_loam"
    SANDY_CLAY_LOAM = "sandy_clay_loam"
    CLAY = "clay"


class Drainage(str, Enum):
    POOR = "poor"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    GOOD = "good"


class Irrigation(str, Enum):
    RAINFED = "rainfed"
    LIMITED = "limited"
    FULL = "full"


class WaterAvailability(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"


class LaborAvailability(str, Enum):
    FAMILY = "family"
    HIRED = "hired"
    MIXED = "mixed"
    SCARCE = "scarce"


class Mechanization(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"


class MarketAccess(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"


class Goal(str, Enum):
    MAX_YIELD = "max_yield"
    MAX_PROFIT = "max_profit"
    LOW_WATER = "low_water"
    LOW_INPUT = "low_input"
    ORGANIC = "organic"
    SOIL_HEALTH = "soil_health"
    RISK_AVERSE = "risk_averse"


class Language(str, Enum):
    TR = "tr"
    EN = "en"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Request models
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Location(BaseModel):
    latitude: float = Field(..., ge=-90, le=90, description="WGS84 latitude")
    longitude: float = Field(..., ge=-180, le=180, description="WGS84 longitude")
    region_name: str | None = Field(None, max_length=120)
    elevation_m: float | None = Field(None, ge=-500, le=9000)

    model_config = ConfigDict(json_schema_extra={"example": {"latitude": 39.93, "longitude": 32.85, "region_name": "Ankara"}})


class FieldProfile(BaseModel):
    area_hectares: float = Field(1.0, gt=0, le=1_000_000)
    soil_texture: SoilTexture = SoilTexture.UNKNOWN
    soil_ph: float | None = Field(None, ge=3.5, le=10.0)
    organic_matter_pct: float | None = Field(None, ge=0, le=30)
    salinity_ds_m: float | None = Field(None, ge=0, le=40)
    soil_depth_cm: float | None = Field(None, ge=10, le=300)
    drainage: Drainage = Drainage.MEDIUM
    slope_pct: float | None = Field(None, ge=0, le=80)
    previous_crop: str | None = Field(None, max_length=80)


class Resources(BaseModel):
    irrigation: Irrigation = Irrigation.RAINFED
    water_availability: WaterAvailability = WaterAvailability.MEDIUM
    budget_usd: float | None = Field(None, ge=0)
    labor: LaborAvailability = LaborAvailability.FAMILY
    mechanization: Mechanization = Mechanization.MEDIUM
    organic_certified: bool = False


class Preferences(BaseModel):
    goal: Goal = Goal.MAX_PROFIT
    crops_of_interest: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=10)
    excluded_crops: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=10)
    planting_month: int | None = Field(None, ge=1, le=12)
    market_access: MarketAccess = MarketAccess.MEDIUM
    max_growing_days: int | None = Field(None, ge=60, le=400)

    @field_validator("crops_of_interest", "excluded_crops")
    @classmethod
    def _clean_crop_names(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        cleaned: list[str] = []
        for value in values:
            item = value.strip()
            if item and item not in cleaned:
                cleaned.append(item)
        return cleaned


class AnalyzeRequest(BaseModel):
    location: Location
    field: FieldProfile = Field(default_factory=FieldProfile)
    resources: Resources = Field(default_factory=Resources)
    preferences: Preferences = Field(default_factory=Preferences)
    top_n: int = Field(3, ge=1, le=8)
    language: Language = Language.TR

    model_config = ConfigDict(
        json_schema_extra={
            "example": {
                "location": {"latitude": 39.93, "longitude": 32.85, "region_name": "Ankara"},
                "field": {
                    "area_hectares": 12.5,
                    "soil_texture": "clay_loam",
                    "soil_ph": 7.4,
                    "organic_matter_pct": 1.8,
                    "drainage": "medium",
                },
                "resources": {
                    "irrigation": "limited",
                    "water_availability": "medium",
                    "budget_usd": 6000,
                    "labor": "family",
                    "mechanization": "medium",
                },
                "preferences": {
                    "goal": "max_profit",
                    "crops_of_interest": ["wheat", "chickpea"],
                    "excluded_crops": [],
                    "planting_month": 10,
                    "market_access": "medium",
                },
                "top_n": 3,
                "language": "tr",
            }
        }
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Environment / NASA data models
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class MonthlyClimate(BaseModel):
    month: str
    mean_temp_c: float | None = None
    min_temp_c: float | None = None
    max_temp_c: float | None = None
    precip_mm_per_day: float | None = None
    precip_month_mm: float | None = None
    relative_humidity_pct: float | None = None
    solar_kwh_m2_day: float | None = None
    wind_speed_m_s: float | None = None
    evapotranspiration_mm_per_day: float | None = None
    root_zone_moisture: float | None = None
    topsoil_moisture: float | None = None
    soil_temp_c: float | None = None
    frost_risk: bool = False
    heat_stress: bool = False


class ClimateSummary(BaseModel):
    annual_mean_temp_c: float | None = None
    growing_season_mean_temp_c: float | None = None
    annual_precip_mm: float | None = None
    annual_evapotranspiration_mm: float | None = None

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CropProfile:
    key: str

    # Growing-season mean temperature envelope (°C)

    organic_suitability: float
    market_demand: float
    gross_margin: float

    notes: str

    @property
    def is_legume(self) -> bool:
        return self.category == "legume"

    def planting_window(self, language: str = "tr") -> str:
        if language == "en":

                "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec",

        else:
            names = MONTH_NAMES_TR
        months = sorted(self.planting_months)
        if len(months) == 1:

        return f"{names[months[0] - 1]}–{names[months[-1] - 1]}"

    ascii_text = ascii_text.replace("ş", "s").replace("ğ", "g").replace("ç", "c").replace("ö", "o").replace("ü", "u")
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", ascii_text).strip()


_ALIAS_MAP: dict[str, str] = {}
for _key, _crop in CROP_CATALOG.items():

def resolve_crop(text: str) -> CropProfile | None:
    """Resolve a free-text crop name (Turkish or English) to a crop profile."""

    if not text:

    normalized = _normalize(text)
    key = _ALIAS_MAP.get(normalized)
    if key:
        return CROP_CATALOG[key]
    # allow "kışlık buğday" / "winter wheat" style suffixes
    for alias, candidate in sorted(_ALIAS_MAP.items(), key=lambda item: len(item[0]), reverse=True):
        if normalized.startswith(alias + " ") or normalized.endswith(" " + alias):
            return CROP_CATALOG[candidate]
    return None

    unknown: list[str] = []
    for value in values:

    problems: list[str] = []

    for crop in CROPS:

        keys.add(crop.key)
        if crop.temp_opt[0] >= crop.temp_opt[1]:

        if crop.temp_abs[0] > crop.temp_opt[0] or crop.temp_abs[1] < crop.temp_opt[1]:

        if crop.ph_opt[0] >= crop.ph_opt[1]:

        if not crop.planting_months or any(m < 1 or m > 12 for m in crop.planting_months):

        for field in (

        if crop.growing_days <= 0 or crop.water_need_mm <= 0:
            problems.append(f"{crop.key}: non-positive growing days / water need")
    return problems

"""NASA POWER API client.

Documentation: https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/services/api/

The client fetches:
* monthly climatology (25-year baseline) for climate and soil-moisture proxies;
* recent daily values (last N days) for a short-term context.

NASA returns ``-999.0`` for missing values; those are normalised to ``None``.
A small in-process TTL cache avoids hammering the public API.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, timedelta
from typing import Any

import httpx

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

CLIMATOLOGY_PARAMETERS = (
    "T2M",
    "T2M_MAX",
    "T2M_MIN",
    "PRECTOTCORR",
    "RH2M",
    "ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN",
    "WS2M",
    "GWETROOT",
    "GWETTOP",
    "TS",
    "EVLAND",
    "EVPTRNS",
)

DAILY_PARAMETERS = (
    "T2M",
    "T2M_MIN",
    "T2M_MAX",
    "PRECTOTCORR",
    "RH2M",
    "GWETROOT",
    "GWETTOP",
)


class NASAAPIError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when NASA POWER cannot provide usable data."""


class _TransientNASAError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class NASAResult:
    latitude: float
    longitude: float
    elevation_m: float | None
    parameters: dict[str, dict[str, float | None]]
    fill_value: float = -999.0
    source_title: str = ""
    api_version: str | None = None
    sources: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    messages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    start: str | None = None
    end: str | None = None


class TTLCache:
    """Tiny thread-safe-enough TTL cache for a single process."""

    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int) -> None:
        self.ttl_seconds = max(0, ttl_seconds)
        self._store: dict[str, tuple[float, Any]] = {}
        self.hits = 0
        self.misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Any | None:
        item = self._store.get(key)
        if item is None:
            self.misses += 1
            return None
        expires_at, value = item
        if time.monotonic() >= expires_at:
            self._store.pop(key, None)
            self.misses += 1
            return None
        self.hits += 1
        return value

    def set(self, key: str, value: Any, ttl_seconds: int | None = None) -> None:
        ttl = self.ttl_seconds if ttl_seconds is None else max(0, ttl_seconds)
        if ttl == 0:
            return
        self._store[key] = (time.monotonic() + ttl, value)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        self._store.clear()

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        self._purge_expired()
        return len(self._store)

    def _purge_expired(self) -> None:
        now = time.monotonic()
        expired = [key for key, (expires_at, _) in self._store.items() if now >= expires_at]
        for key in expired:
            self._store.pop(key, None)


def _to_float(value: Any) -> float | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    try:
        number = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return number


def parse_nasa_payload(
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    start: str | None = None,
    end: str | None = None,
) -> NASAResult:
    """Convert a raw NASA POWER JSON response into a typed result."""

    try:
        coordinates = payload["geometry"]["coordinates"]
        parameters_raw = payload["properties"]["parameter"]
    except (KeyError, TypeError) as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
        raise NASAAPIError("NASA POWER yanıtı beklenen biçimde değil.") from exc

    header = payload.get("header", {}) or {}
    fill_value = _to_float(header.get("fill_value"))
    if fill_value is None:
        fill_value = -999.0

    parameters: dict[str, dict[str, float | None]] = {}
    for parameter, series in parameters_raw.items():
        if not isinstance(series, dict):
            continue
        cleaned: dict[str, float | None] = {}
        for key, value in series.items():
            number = _to_float(value)
            cleaned[key] = None if number is None or number == fill_value else number
        parameters[parameter] = cleaned

    elevation = None
    if isinstance(coordinates, (list, tuple)) and len(coordinates) >= 3:
        elevation = _to_float(coordinates[2])
        if elevation is not None and elevation <= -999:
            elevation = None

    api_meta = header.get("api", {}) or {}
    return NASAResult(
        latitude=float(coordinates[1]),
        longitude=float(coordinates[0]),
        elevation_m=elevation,
        parameters=parameters,
        fill_value=fill_value,
        source_title=str(header.get("title", "")),
        api_version=api_meta.get("version"),
        sources=list(header.get("sources", []) or []),
        messages=list(payload.get("messages", []) or []),
        start=start,
        end=end,
    )


class NASAPowerClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str = "https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal",
        *,
        community: str = "AG",
        timeout_seconds: float = 30.0,
        cache_ttl_seconds: int = 3600,
        daily_cache_ttl_seconds: int = 1800,
        max_retries: int = 2,
        retry_backoff_seconds: float = 0.75,
        transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.community = community
        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self.retry_backoff_seconds = retry_backoff_seconds
        self.cache = TTLCache(cache_ttl_seconds)
        self.daily_cache_ttl_seconds = daily_cache_ttl_seconds
        self._client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout_seconds),
            transport=transport,
            headers={
                "User-Agent": "Project-Alphecca/0.1 (agricultural decision support)",
                "Accept": "application/json",
            },
        )

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._client.aclose()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Public API
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    async def get_climatology(
        self,
        latitude: float,
        longitude: float,
        *,
        parameters: tuple[str, ...] = CLIMATOLOGY_PARAMETERS,
    ) -> NASAResult:
        key = f"clim:{latitude:.3f}:{longitude:.3f}:{self.community}:{','.join(parameters)}"
        cached = self.cache.get(key)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached

        result = await self._request(
            "climatology/point",
            latitude=latitude,
            longitude=longitude,
            parameters=parameters,
        )
        self.cache.set(key, result)
        return result

    async def get_daily(
        self,
        latitude: float,
        longitude: float,
        *,
        days: int = 30,
        parameters: tuple[str, ...] = DAILY_PARAMETERS,
        end_date: date | None = None,
    ) -> NASAResult:
        days = max(1, min(days, 366))
        end = end_date or date.today()
        start = end - timedelta(days=days - 1)
        start_text = start.strftime("%Y%m%d")
        end_text = end.strftime("%Y%m%d")
        key = (
            f"daily:{latitude:.3f}:{longitude:.3f}:{start_text}:{end_text}:"
            f"{self.community}:{','.join(parameters)}"
        )
        cached = self.cache.get(key)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached

        result = await self._request(
            "daily/point",
            latitude=latitude,
            longitude=longitude,
            parameters=parameters,
            start=start_text,
            end=end_text,
        )
        result = NASAResult(
            latitude=result.latitude,
            longitude=result.longitude,
            elevation_m=result.elevation_m,
            parameters=result.parameters,
            fill_value=result.fill_value,
            source_title=result.source_title,
            api_version=result.api_version,
            sources=result.sources,
            messages=result.messages,
            start=start_text,
            end=end_text,
        )
        self.cache.set(key, result, ttl_seconds=self.daily_cache_ttl_seconds)
        return result

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Internals
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    async def _request(self, path: str, **params: Any) -> NASAResult:
        url = f"{self.base_url}/{path.lstrip('/')}"
        query: dict[str, Any] = {
            "parameters": ",".join(params.pop("parameters")),
            "community": self.community,
            "latitude": round(float(params.pop("latitude")), 4),
            "longitude": round(float(params.pop("longitude")), 4),
            "format": "JSON",
        }
        query.update(params)

        last_error: Exception | None = None
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            try:
                response = await self._client.get(url, params=query)
                if response.status_code in {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}:
                    raise _TransientNASAError(
                        f"NASA POWER geçici hata döndürdü (HTTP {response.status_code})."
                    )
                if response.status_code >= 400:
                    detail = response.text[:300].replace("\n", " ")
                    raise NASAAPIError(
                        f"NASA POWER isteği başarısız (HTTP {response.status_code}): {detail}"
                    )
                try:
                    payload = response.json()
                except ValueError as exc:
                    raise NASAAPIError("NASA POWER geçerli JSON döndürmedi.") from exc
                return parse_nasa_payload(payload)
            except (_TransientNASAError, httpx.TimeoutException, httpx.TransportError) as exc:
                last_error = exc
                if attempt >= self.max_retries:
                    break
                delay = self.retry_backoff_seconds * (2**attempt)
                logger.warning(
                    "NASA POWER isteği yeniden denenecek (%s/%s): %s",
                    attempt + 1,
                    self.max_retries,
                    exc,
                )
                if delay > 0:
                    await asyncio.sleep(delay)

        raise NASAAPIError(
            "NASA POWER servisine ulaşılamadı. İnternet bağlantısını kontrol edip "
            "birkaç dakika sonra tekrar deneyin."
        ) from last_error

    (Irrigation.LIMITED, WaterAvailability.MEDIUM): 120.0,
    (Irrigation.LIMITED, WaterAvailability.HIGH): 180.0,
    (Irrigation.FULL, WaterAvailability.LOW): 180.0,
    (Irrigation.FULL, WaterAvailability.MEDIUM): 350.0,
    (Irrigation.FULL, WaterAvailability.HIGH): 500.0,
}


def _mean(values: Iterable[float | None]) -> float | None:
    present = [value for value in values if value is not None]
    if not present:
        return None
    return sum(present) / len(present)


def _sum(values: Iterable[float | None]) -> float | None:
    present = [value for value in values if value is not None]
    if not present:
        return None
    return sum(present)


def _round(value: float | None, digits: int = 2) -> float | None:
    return None if value is None else round(value, digits)


def _parameter_by_month(result: NASAResult, parameter: str) -> dict[int, float | None]:
    series = result.parameters.get(parameter, {})
    return {index + 1: series.get(key) for index, key in enumerate(MONTH_KEYS)}


def _band_score(
    value: float | None,
    optimal: tuple[float, float],
    hard: tuple[float, float],
) -> float | None:
    """Linear 0-100 score that is 100 inside ``optimal`` and 0 outside ``hard``."""

    if value is None:
        return None
    low, high = optimal
    hard_low, hard_high = hard
    if low <= value <= high:
        return 100.0
    if value < low:
        if value <= hard_low:
            return 0.0
        return 100.0 * (value - hard_low) / (low - hard_low)
    if value >= hard_high:
        return 0.0
    return 100.0 * (hard_high - value) / (hard_high - high)


def irrigation_supply_mm(resources: Resources) -> float:
    """Effective seasonal irrigation supply used in the water balance."""

    return IRRIGATION_SUPPLY_MM.get((resources.irrigation, resources.water_availability), 0.0)


def summarize_climate(climatology: NASAResult) -> ClimateSummary:
    t2m = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M")
    tmax = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M_MAX")
    tmin = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M_MIN")
    precip_day = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "PRECTOTCORR")
    solar = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN")
    evland = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "EVLAND")
    evptrns = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "EVPTRNS")

    monthly_precip = {
        month: (None if precip_day[month] is None else precip_day[month] * MONTH_DAYS[month - 1])
        for month in range(1, 13)
    }
    annual_precip = _sum(monthly_precip.values())

    evap_daily = evland if any(v is not None for v in evland.values()) else evptrns
    monthly_evap = {
        month: (None if evap_daily[month] is None else evap_daily[month] * MONTH_DAYS[month - 1])
        for month in range(1, 13)
    }
    annual_evap = _sum(monthly_evap.values())

    aridity_index = None
    if annual_precip is not None and annual_evap and annual_evap > 0:
        aridity_index = annual_precip / annual_evap

    if aridity_index is None:
        climate_class = "unknown"
    elif aridity_index < 0.05:
        climate_class = "hyper_arid"
    elif aridity_index < 0.20:
        climate_class = "arid"
    elif aridity_index < 0.50:
        climate_class = "semi_arid"
    elif aridity_index < 0.65:
        climate_class = "dry_sub_humid"
    elif aridity_index < 1.0:
        climate_class = "humid"
    else:
        climate_class = "per_humid"

    growing_months = [month for month in range(1, 13) if (t2m[month] or -99) >= 5.0]
    growing_days = sum(MONTH_DAYS[month - 1] for month in growing_months)
    growing_temps = [t2m[month] for month in growing_months if t2m[month] is not None]

    frost_months = [
        MONTH_NAMES_TR[month - 1]
        for month in range(1, 13)
        if tmin[month] is not None and tmin[month] < 0
    ]
    heat_months = [
        MONTH_NAMES_TR[month - 1]
        for month in range(1, 13)
        if tmax[month] is not None and tmax[month] >= 32
    ]

    return ClimateSummary(
        annual_mean_temp_c=_round(_mean(t2m.values())),
        growing_season_mean_temp_c=_round(_mean(growing_temps)),
        annual_precip_mm=_round(annual_precip, 1),
        annual_evapotranspiration_mm=_round(annual_evap, 1),
        aridity_index=_round(aridity_index, 3),
        climate_class=climate_class,
        growing_season_days=growing_days or None,
        frost_months=frost_months,
        heat_stress_months=heat_months,
        annual_solar_kwh_m2_day=_round(_mean(solar.values())),
    )


def summarize_soil(climatology: NASAResult, field: FieldProfile) -> SoilSummary:
    gwetroot = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "GWETROOT")
    gwettop = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "GWETTOP")
    soil_temp = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "TS")

    root_mean = _mean(gwetroot.values())
    top_mean = _mean(gwettop.values())
    soil_temp_mean = _mean(soil_temp.values())

    scores: list[tuple[float, float]] = []
    moisture_score = _band_score(root_mean, (0.40, 0.70), (0.0, 1.0))
    if moisture_score is not None:
        scores.append((moisture_score, 0.40))
    temp_score = _band_score(soil_temp_mean, (15.0, 25.0), (0.0, 40.0))
    if temp_score is not None:
        scores.append((temp_score, 0.25))
    ph_score = _band_score(field.soil_ph, (6.2, 7.5), (4.0, 9.5))
    if ph_score is not None:
        scores.append((ph_score, 0.20))
    organic_score = _band_score(field.organic_matter_pct, (2.5, 8.0), (0.0, 12.0))
    if organic_score is not None:
        scores.append((organic_score, 0.15))

    condition_score = None
    if scores:
        total_weight = sum(weight for _, weight in scores)
        condition_score = sum(score * weight for score, weight in scores) / total_weight

    gaps: list[str] = []
    if field.soil_ph is None:
        gaps.append("Toprak pH'ı girilmedi; pH puanı NASA verisinden tahmin edilemez.")
    if field.organic_matter_pct is None:
        gaps.append("Organik madde oranı girilmedi; toprak analizi önerilir.")
    if field.soil_texture == SoilTexture.UNKNOWN:
        gaps.append("Toprak dokusu girilmedi; bünye uyumu varsayılan puanla değerlendirildi.")
    if field.salinity_ds_m is None:
        gaps.append("Toprak tuzluluğu (EC) girilmedi; tuzluluk riski sınırlı doğrulukla değerlendirildi.")
    gaps.append(
        "NASA POWER besin elementleri (N-P-K) ve organik madde sağlamaz; "
        "bu değerler çiftçi beyanı veya laboratuvar analizi ile doğrulanmalıdır."
    )

    return SoilSummary(
        root_zone_moisture_mean=_round(root_mean, 3),
        topsoil_moisture_mean=_round(top_mean, 3),
        mean_soil_temp_c=_round(soil_temp_mean),
        soil_condition_score=_round(condition_score, 1),
        soil_condition_label=soil_condition_label(condition_score),
        soil_texture=field.soil_texture,
        soil_ph=field.soil_ph,
        organic_matter_pct=field.organic_matter_pct,
        salinity_ds_m=field.salinity_ds_m,
        drainage=field.drainage,
        data_gaps=gaps,
    )


def soil_condition_label(score: float | None) -> str | None:
    if score is None:
        return None
    if score >= 80:
        return "iyi"
    if score >= 60:
        return "orta"
    if score >= 40:
        return "zayıf"
    return "çok zayıf"


def summarize_recent_weather(daily: NASAResult, window_days: int) -> RecentWeather | None:
    temps = daily.parameters.get("T2M", {})
    tmax = daily.parameters.get("T2M_MAX", {})
    tmin = daily.parameters.get("T2M_MIN", {})
    precip = daily.parameters.get("PRECTOTCORR", {})
    moisture = daily.parameters.get("GWETROOT", {})

    dates = sorted(temps.keys())
    available_temps = [temps[d] for d in dates if temps[d] is not None]
    if not available_temps:
        return None

    precip_values = [precip.get(d) for d in dates]
    valid_precip = [value for value in precip_values if value is not None]

    rainy_days = None
    longest_dry = None
    if valid_precip:
        rainy_days = sum(1 for value in valid_precip if value >= 1.0)
        longest = current = 0
        for value in precip_values:
            if value is None:
                current = 0
            elif value < 1.0:
                current += 1
                longest = max(longest, current)
            else:
                current = 0
        longest_dry = longest

    tmax_values = [tmax[d] for d in dates if tmax.get(d) is not None]
    tmin_values = [tmin[d] for d in dates if tmin.get(d) is not None]
    moisture_values = [moisture[d] for d in dates if moisture.get(d) is not None]

    return RecentWeather(
        window_days=window_days,
        available_days=len(available_temps),
        mean_temp_c=_round(_mean(available_temps)),
        min_temp_c=_round(min(tmin_values) if tmin_values else min(available_temps)),
        max_temp_c=_round(max(tmax_values) if tmax_values else max(available_temps)),
        total_precip_mm=_round(sum(valid_precip), 1) if valid_precip else None,
        rainy_days=rainy_days,
        longest_dry_spell_days=longest_dry,
        mean_root_zone_moisture=_round(_mean(moisture_values), 3),
    )


def build_environment(
    climatology: NASAResult,
    daily: NASAResult | None,
    field: FieldProfile,
    *,
    recent_days: int = 30,
) -> tuple[EnvironmentSnapshot, list[str]]:
    climate = summarize_climate(climatology)
    soil = summarize_soil(climatology, field)

    monthly: list[MonthlyClimate] = []
    t2m = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M")
    tmax = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M_MAX")
    tmin = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M_MIN")
    precip = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "PRECTOTCORR")
    humidity = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "RH2M")
    solar = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN")
    wind = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "WS2M")
    evap = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "EVLAND")
    root_moisture = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "GWETROOT")
    top_moisture = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "GWETTOP")
    soil_temp = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "TS")

    for month in range(1, 13):
        monthly.append(
            MonthlyClimate(
                month=MONTH_NAMES_TR[month - 1],
                mean_temp_c=_round(t2m[month]),
                min_temp_c=_round(tmin[month]),
                max_temp_c=_round(tmax[month]),
                precip_mm_per_day=_round(precip[month]),
                precip_month_mm=_round(
                    None if precip[month] is None else precip[month] * MONTH_DAYS[month - 1], 1
                ),
                relative_humidity_pct=_round(humidity[month]),
                solar_kwh_m2_day=_round(solar[month]),
                wind_speed_m_s=_round(wind[month]),
                evapotranspiration_mm_per_day=_round(evap[month]),
                root_zone_moisture=_round(root_moisture[month], 3),
                topsoil_moisture=_round(top_moisture[month], 3),
                soil_temp_c=_round(soil_temp[month]),
                frost_risk=bool(tmin[month] is not None and tmin[month] < 0),
                heat_stress=bool(tmax[month] is not None and tmax[month] >= 32),
            )
        )

    recent = summarize_recent_weather(daily, recent_days) if daily is not None else None

    notes = list(soil.data_gaps)
    notes.append(
        "NASA POWER iklim verisi 25 yıllık (2001-2025) grid tabanlı bir ortalamadır; "
        "tarla ölçeğinde ve bu yılın gerçek hasat verisi değildir."
    )
    notes.append(
        "NASA POWER çözünürlüğü yaklaşık 0.5° × 0.625°'dir (ekvatora yakın ~50-70 km). "
        "Aynı grid hücresindeki iki tarla farklı toprak koşullarına sahip olabilir."
    )
    if daily is not None and recent is not None and recent.available_days < recent_days:
        notes.append(
            f"Son {recent_days} günün yalnızca {recent.available_days} günü için geçerli veri bulundu; "
            "NASA POWER'da son günler gecikmeli olabilir."
        )
    if recent is None:
        notes.append("Son günlük hava verisi alınamadı; analiz iklim ortalamalarına dayanıyor.")

    env = EnvironmentSnapshot(
        nasa_elevation_m=_round(climatology.elevation_m, 1),
        climate=climate,
        soil=soil,
        recent_weather=recent,
        monthly=monthly,
        notes=notes,
    )
    return env, notes

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SeasonMetrics:
    start_month: int
    months: tuple[int, ...]
    window_label: str
    mean_temp_c: float | None
    total_precip_mm: float | None
    frost_months: list[str]
    heat_months: list[str]

    @property
    def days(self) -> int:
        return sum(MONTH_DAYS[month - 1] for month in self.months)


def month_span_label(months: tuple[int, ...]) -> str:
    if not months:
        return ""
    if len(months) == 1:
        return MONTH_NAMES_TR[months[0] - 1]
    return f"{MONTH_NAMES_TR[months[0] - 1]}–{MONTH_NAMES_TR[months[-1] - 1]}"


def choose_start_month(crop: CropProfile, preferred_month: int | None) -> int:
    months = crop.planting_months
    if not months:
        return 1
    if preferred_month is None:
        return months[0]
    if preferred_month in months:
        return preferred_month

    def circular_distance(month: int, target: int) -> int:
        raw = abs(month - target)
        return min(raw, 12 - raw)

    return min(months, key=lambda month: circular_distance(month, preferred_month))


def season_metrics(
    environment: EnvironmentSnapshot,
    crop: CropProfile,
    preferred_month: int | None = None,
) -> SeasonMetrics:
    start = choose_start_month(crop, preferred_month)
    length = max(1, min(12, math.ceil(crop.growing_days / 30)))
    months = tuple(((start - 1 + offset) % 12) + 1 for offset in range(length))

    monthly_by_number = {index + 1: item for index, item in enumerate(environment.monthly)}
    temps = [monthly_by_number[m].mean_temp_c for m in months]
    precip = [monthly_by_number[m].precip_month_mm for m in months]
    frost = [
        monthly_by_number[m].month
        for m in months
        if monthly_by_number[m].frost_risk
    ]
    heat = [
        monthly_by_number[m].month
        for m in months
        if monthly_by_number[m].heat_stress
    ]

    return SeasonMetrics(
        start_month=start,
        months=months,
        window_label=month_span_label(months),
        mean_temp_c=_round(_mean(temps)),
        total_precip_mm=_round(_sum(precip), 1),
        frost_months=frost,
        heat_months=heat,
    )

"""AI abstraction layer.

The product treats the LLM as an *advisor on top of* a deterministic agronomy
engine, never as the only source of truth. This module defines the common
contract, prompt construction and robust JSON parsing.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

from app.domain.scoring import CropEvaluation
from app.schemas import AnalyzeRequest, EnvironmentSnapshot, Language


class AIProviderError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when an AI provider cannot return a usable analysis."""


class AICropAssessment(BaseModel):
    crop_key: str
    ai_score: float = Field(70.0, ge=0, le=100)
    rationale: str = ""
    risks: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    actions: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    planting_window: str | None = None


class AIAnalysis(BaseModel):
    summary: str = ""
    crops: list[AICropAssessment] = Field(default_factory=list)
    general_risks: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    general_actions: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    confidence: Literal["low", "medium", "high"] = "medium"
    notes: str | None = None

    @field_validator("confidence", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_confidence(cls, value: Any) -> str:
        text = str(value or "medium").strip().lower()
        return text if text in {"low", "medium", "high"} else "medium"


class AIContext(BaseModel):
    """Compact, JSON-safe payload sent to the LLM."""

    language: str
    location: dict[str, Any]
    farmer: dict[str, Any]
    environment: dict[str, Any]
    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]]
    data_quality: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class AIProvider(ABC):
    name: str = "base"
    model: str | None = None
    kind: Literal["llm", "deterministic"] = "llm"

    @abstractmethod
    async def analyze(self, context: AIContext) -> AIAnalysis:
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def aclose(self) -> None:  # pragma: no cover - trivial default
        return None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Context / prompt builders
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def build_ai_context(
    request: AnalyzeRequest,
    environment: EnvironmentSnapshot,
    evaluations: list[CropEvaluation],
    *,
    max_candidates: int = 8,
) -> AIContext:
    environment_payload = {
        "elevation_m": environment.nasa_elevation_m,
        "climate": environment.climate.model_dump(mode="json"),
        "soil": environment.soil.model_dump(mode="json"),
        "recent_weather": (
            environment.recent_weather.model_dump(mode="json")
            if environment.recent_weather
            else None
        ),
        "notes": environment.notes,
    }
    candidates = []
    for evaluation in evaluations[:max_candidates]:
        candidates.append(
            {
                "crop_key": evaluation.crop.key,
                "crop_name": evaluation.crop.name,
                "crop_name_local": evaluation.crop.local_name,
                "category": evaluation.crop.category,
                "rule_score": evaluation.rule_score,
                "component_scores": evaluation.components,
                "strengths": evaluation.strengths,
                "limiting_factors": evaluation.limiting_factors,
                "season": (
                    {
                        "window": evaluation.season.window_label,
                        "mean_temp_c": evaluation.season.mean_temp_c,
                        "total_precip_mm": evaluation.season.total_precip_mm,
                        "frost_months": evaluation.season.frost_months,
                        "heat_months": evaluation.season.heat_months,
                    }
                    if evaluation.season
                    else None
                ),
                "water_need_mm": evaluation.crop.water_need_mm,
                "growing_days": evaluation.crop.growing_days,
                "planting_window": evaluation.crop.planting_window(request.language.value),
            }
        )

    return AIContext(
        language=request.language.value,
        location=request.location.model_dump(mode="json"),
        farmer={
            "field": request.field.model_dump(mode="json"),
            "resources": request.resources.model_dump(mode="json"),
            "preferences": request.preferences.model_dump(mode="json"),
        },
        environment=environment_payload,
        candidates=candidates,
        data_quality=environment.notes,
    )


SYSTEM_PROMPT_TR = """Sen deneyimli bir tarım agronomisti ve çiftçi karar destek asistanısın.
Sana NASA POWER verilerinden türetilmiş iklim/toprak özeti, çiftçi profili ve deterministik
bir kural motorunun puanladığı aday ekinler veriliyor.

Görevin:
1. Adayları çiftçinin hedefi, kaynakları ve bölge koşullarına göre yeniden değerlendirmek.
2. Her aday için kısa, somut gerekçe; riskler ve uygulanabilir aksiyonlar yazmak.
3. Verilmeyen bir veriyi ASLA uydurmamak. Eksik veriyi açıkça belirtmek.
4. Kesin verim, gelir veya kâr garantisi vermemek; bunun yerine olasılık ve risk dili kullanmak.
5. Yalnızca geçerli JSON döndürmek. Markdown, kod bloğu veya JSON dışında metin yazmamak.

Önemli sınırlar:
- NASA POWER grid tabanlıdır ve tarla ölçeğinde değildir.
- NASA POWER toprak besin içeriği (N-P-K), pH veya organik madde sağlamaz.
- Yerel çeşit, pazar fiyatı, yasal kısıt ve uzman görüşü verilmediyse bunları varsayma.
- Türkçe yanıt ver (language="tr" ise). Teknik terimleri çiftçinin anlayacağı dille açıkla.
- Aday listesinde olmayan bir crop_key üretme.
"""

SYSTEM_PROMPT_EN = """You are an experienced agronomist and farmer decision-support assistant.
You receive a climate/soil summary derived from NASA POWER data, a farmer profile and
candidate crops scored by a deterministic rule engine.

Your job:
1. Re-evaluate candidates against the farmer's goal, resources and local conditions.
2. For each candidate, provide a concise rationale, risks and actionable steps.
3. NEVER invent data that was not provided. State gaps explicitly.
4. Do not guarantee yield, income or profit; use probabilistic and risk-aware language.
5. Return valid JSON only. No markdown, code fences or text outside the JSON.

Hard limits:
- NASA POWER is gridded, not field-scale.
- NASA POWER does not provide soil nutrients (N-P-K), pH or organic matter.
- Do not assume local varieties, market prices, regulations or expert advice unless provided.
- Respond in English when language="en".
- Do not emit a crop_key that is not in the candidate list.
"""

OUTPUT_SCHEMA = {
    "summary": "2-4 sentence overall recommendation in the requested language",
    "crops": [
        {
            "crop_key": "one of the candidate crop_key values",
            "ai_score": "0-100 number; your agronomic confidence-adjusted score",
            "rationale": "2-4 sentences, specific to the provided data",
            "risks": ["2-4 concrete risks"],
            "actions": ["2-5 concrete, executable actions"],
            "planting_window": "short text",
        }
    ],
    "general_risks": ["cross-cutting risks"],
    "general_actions": ["cross-cutting next steps"],
    "confidence": "low | medium | high",
    "notes": "data gaps or caveats, optional",
}


def build_messages(context: AIContext) -> tuple[str, str]:
    system = SYSTEM_PROMPT_TR if context.language == "tr" else SYSTEM_PROMPT_EN
    user_payload = {
        "task": "Rank the candidate crops and explain the recommendation.",
        "output_schema": OUTPUT_SCHEMA,
        "context": context.model_dump(mode="json"),
    }
    user = (
        "Aşağıdaki JSON bağlamını kullan. Sadece output_schema'ya uygun JSON döndür.\n\n"
        if context.language == "tr"
        else "Use the JSON context below. Return only JSON matching output_schema.\n\n"
    )
    user += json.dumps(user_payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    return system, user


def extract_json_object(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Extract the first JSON object from an LLM response."""

    if not text or not text.strip():
        raise AIProviderError("AI sağlayıcısı boş yanıt döndürdü.")

    cleaned = text.strip()
    if cleaned.startswith("```"):
        cleaned = cleaned.split("\n", 1)[-1]
        if cleaned.endswith("```"):
            cleaned = cleaned[:-3]
    start = cleaned.find("{")
    end = cleaned.rfind("}")
    if start == -1 or end == -1 or end <= start:
        raise AIProviderError("AI yanıtında JSON nesnesi bulunamadı.")
    try:
        payload = json.loads(cleaned[start : end + 1])
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise AIProviderError(f"AI yanıtı geçerli JSON değil: {exc.msg}") from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise AIProviderError("AI yanıtı JSON nesnesi değil.")
    return payload


def parse_analysis(text: str, allowed_crop_keys: set[str] | None = None) -> AIAnalysis:
    analysis = AIAnalysis.model_validate(extract_json_object(text))
    if allowed_crop_keys is not None:
        analysis.crops = [crop for crop in analysis.crops if crop.crop_key in allowed_crop_keys]
    return analysis

"""OpenAI-compatible chat completion provider.

Works with OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, Together, OpenRouter and a
local Ollama server (all expose ``POST /chat/completions``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

import httpx

from app.ai.base import AIAnalysis, AIContext, AIProvider, AIProviderError, build_messages, parse_analysis

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class OpenAICompatibleProvider(AIProvider):
    kind = "llm"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        base_url: str,
        api_key: str | None,
        model: str,
        timeout_seconds: float = 45.0,
        temperature: float = 0.2,
        max_tokens: int = 1600,
        json_mode: bool = True,
        transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.model = model
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
        self.json_mode = json_mode
        self._client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout_seconds),
            transport=transport,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._client.aclose()

    async def analyze(self, context: AIContext) -> AIAnalysis:
        if not self.api_key and self.name not in {"ollama"}:
            raise AIProviderError(f"{self.name} için API anahtarı tanımlı değil.")

        system, user = build_messages(context)
        base_payload = {
            "model": self.model,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": system},
                {"role": "user", "content": user},
            ],
            "temperature": self.temperature,
            "max_tokens": self.max_tokens,
        }
        headers = {}
        if self.api_key:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.api_key}"

        payload = dict(base_payload)
        if self.json_mode:
            payload["response_format"] = {"type": "json_object"}

        response = await self._client.post(
            f"{self.base_url}/chat/completions", json=payload, headers=headers
        )

        # Some OpenAI-compatible servers reject response_format. Retry once
        # without it instead of failing the whole request.
        if response.status_code == 400 and self.json_mode:
            logger.info("%s response_format desteklemedi; json_mode olmadan yeniden denenecek.", self.name)
            payload = dict(base_payload)
            response = await self._client.post(
                f"{self.base_url}/chat/completions", json=payload, headers=headers
            )

        if response.status_code >= 400:
            detail = response.text[:400].replace("\n", " ")
            raise AIProviderError(
                f"{self.name} API hatası (HTTP {response.status_code}): {detail}"
            )

        try:
            data = response.json()
            content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise AIProviderError(f"{self.name} yanıtı beklenen biçimde değil.") from exc

        if isinstance(content, list):
            content = "".join(
                part.get("text", "") for part in content if isinstance(part, dict)
            )

        allowed = {candidate["crop_key"] for candidate in context.candidates}
        return parse_analysis(str(content), allowed_crop_keys=allowed)

"""Google Gemini (Generative Language API) provider."""

from __future__ import annotations

import httpx

from app.ai.base import AIAnalysis, AIContext, AIProvider, AIProviderError, build_messages, parse_analysis


class GeminiProvider(AIProvider):
    name = "gemini"
    kind = "llm"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        api_key: str,
        model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash",
        base_url: str = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta",
        timeout_seconds: float = 45.0,
        temperature: float = 0.2,
        max_tokens: int = 1600,
        transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.model = model
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
        self._client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout_seconds),
            transport=transport,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._client.aclose()

    async def analyze(self, context: AIContext) -> AIAnalysis:
        if not self.api_key:
            raise AIProviderError("Gemini için API anahtarı tanımlı değil.")

        system, user = build_messages(context)
        payload = {
            "systemInstruction": {"parts": [{"text": system}]},
            "contents": [{"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": user}]}],
            "generationConfig": {
                "temperature": self.temperature,
                "maxOutputTokens": self.max_tokens,
                "responseMimeType": "application/json",
            },
        }
        response = await self._client.post(
            f"{self.base_url}/models/{self.model}:generateContent",
            params={"key": self.api_key},
            json=payload,
        )
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            detail = response.text[:400].replace("\n", " ")
            raise AIProviderError(f"Gemini API hatası (HTTP {response.status_code}): {detail}")

        try:
            data = response.json()
            parts = data["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"]
            content = "".join(part.get("text", "") for part in parts if isinstance(part, dict))
        except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise AIProviderError("Gemini yanıtı beklenen biçimde değil.") from exc

        allowed = {candidate["crop_key"] for candidate in context.candidates}
        return parse_analysis(content, allowed_crop_keys=allowed)

"""Anthropic Claude (Messages API) provider."""

from __future__ import annotations

import httpx

from app.ai.base import AIAnalysis, AIContext, AIProvider, AIProviderError, build_messages, parse_analysis


class AnthropicProvider(AIProvider):
    name = "anthropic"
    kind = "llm"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        api_key: str,
        model: str = "claude-sonnet-4-5",
        base_url: str = "https://api.anthropic.com/v1",
        timeout_seconds: float = 45.0,
        temperature: float = 0.2,
        max_tokens: int = 1600,
        transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.model = model
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
        self._client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout_seconds),
            transport=transport,
            headers={
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "x-api-key": api_key,
                "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
            },
        )

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._client.aclose()

    async def analyze(self, context: AIContext) -> AIAnalysis:
        if not self.api_key:
            raise AIProviderError("Anthropic için API anahtarı tanımlı değil.")

        system, user = build_messages(context)
        payload = {
            "model": self.model,
            "max_tokens": self.max_tokens,
            "temperature": self.temperature,
            "system": system,
            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": user}],
        }
        response = await self._client.post(f"{self.base_url}/messages", json=payload)
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            detail = response.text[:400].replace("\n", " ")
            raise AIProviderError(f"Anthropic API hatası (HTTP {response.status_code}): {detail}")

        try:
            data = response.json()
            content = "".join(
                block.get("text", "")
                for block in data["content"]
                if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "text"
            )
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise AIProviderError("Anthropic yanıtı beklenen biçimde değil.") from exc

        allowed = {candidate["crop_key"] for candidate in context.candidates}
        return parse_analysis(content, allowed_crop_keys=allowed)

"""End-to-end recommendation orchestration."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import uuid4

from app.ai.base import AIAnalysis, AICropAssessment, AIProviderError, build_ai_context
from app.ai.heuristic import HeuristicProvider
from app.clients.nasa_power import NASAAPIError, NASAPowerClient
from app.config import Settings
from app.domain.crops import CropProfile
from app.domain.scoring import CropEvaluation, evaluate_candidates
from app.schemas import (
    AIMetadata,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    CropRecommendation,
    DataSource,
    EnvironmentResponse,
    EnvironmentSnapshot,
    Language,
    Location,
    ScoreBreakdown,
)
from app.services.agronomy import build_environment

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class AnalysisError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, message: str, *, status_code: int = 422, code: str = "analysis_error") -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.code = code


DISCLAIMER_TR = (
    "Bu çıktı bir karar destek aracıdır; verim, gelir veya kâr garantisi değildir. "
    "NASA POWER verileri grid tabanlı ve geçmişe dönük ortalamalardır, tarla ölçeğinde değildir. "
    "Ekim, gübreleme, ilaçlama ve sulama kararlarından önce toprak analizi yaptırın ve "
    "yetkili bir tarım uzmanına / il-ilçe tarım müdürlüğüne danışın."
)

DISCLAIMER_EN = (
    "This output is decision support, not a guarantee of yield, income or profit. "
    "NASA POWER data is gridded and climatological, not field-scale. "
    "Before planting, fertilising, spraying or irrigating, obtain a soil test and consult "
    "a qualified agronomist or the local extension service."
)


class RecommendationService:
    def __init__(self, nasa_client: NASAPowerClient, ai_provider, settings: Settings) -> None:
        self.nasa = nasa_client
        self.ai = ai_provider
        self.settings = settings
        self.heuristic = HeuristicProvider()

    async def environment(
        self,
        location: Location,
        field,
        *,
        recent_days: int = 30,
    ) -> EnvironmentResponse:
        warnings: list[str] = []
        climatology = await self.nasa.get_climatology(location.latitude, location.longitude)
        daily = None
        try:
            daily = await self.nasa.get_daily(
                location.latitude, location.longitude, days=recent_days
            )
        except NASAAPIError as exc:
            warnings.append(f"Son günlük hava verisi alınamadı: {exc}")

        environment, _ = build_environment(
            climatology, daily, field, recent_days=recent_days
        )
        return EnvironmentResponse(
            generated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            location=location,
            environment=environment,
            warnings=warnings,
        )

    async def analyze(self, request: AnalyzeRequest) -> AnalyzeResponse:
        warnings: list[str] = []
        climatology = await self.nasa.get_climatology(
            request.location.latitude, request.location.longitude
        )
        daily = None
        try:
            daily = await self.nasa.get_daily(
                request.location.latitude, request.location.longitude, days=30
            )
        except NASAAPIError as exc:
            warnings.append(
                f"Son 30 günlük hava verisi alınamadı; analiz iklim ortalamalarıyla yapıldı ({exc})."
            )

        environment, _ = build_environment(climatology, daily, request.field, recent_days=30)
        evaluations, scoring_warnings = evaluate_candidates(request, environment)
        warnings.extend(scoring_warnings)

        if not evaluations:
            raise AnalysisError(
                "Seçilen filtrelerle değerlendirilebilecek ekin kalmadı. Hariç listesini veya sezon süresi sınırını gevşetin.",
                status_code=422,
                code="no_candidates",
            )

        context = build_ai_context(
            request,
            environment,
            evaluations,
            max_candidates=self.settings.max_ai_candidates,
        )

        ai_result, ai_meta = await self._run_ai(context, warnings)

        heuristic_result = await self.heuristic.analyze(context)
        recommendations = self._merge(
            request, environment, evaluations, ai_result, heuristic_result, ai_meta
        )

        used_ai = ai_meta.kind == "llm" and ai_meta.used and not ai_meta.fallback_used
        if used_ai:
            warnings.append(
                "AI tarafından üretilen gerekçe ve aksiyonlar doğrulanmamış olabilir; "
                "saha kararından önce agronomist kontrolü yapın."
            )

        summary = (ai_result.summary or heuristic_result.summary).strip()
        if not summary:
            summary = heuristic_result.summary

        general_risks = ai_result.general_risks or heuristic_result.general_risks
        general_actions = ai_result.general_actions or heuristic_result.general_actions

        if ai_meta.kind == "deterministic" and isinstance(self.ai, HeuristicProvider) and self.ai.reason:
            warnings.append(self.ai.reason)

        return AnalyzeResponse(
            analysis_id=uuid4().hex,
            generated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            language=request.language,
            location=request.location,
            environment=environment,
            recommendations=recommendations,
            summary=summary,
            general_risks=self._dedupe(general_risks)[:6],
            general_actions=self._dedupe(general_actions)[:8],
            warnings=self._dedupe(warnings),
            data_sources=self._data_sources(request, daily is not None, ai_meta),
            ai=ai_meta,
            disclaimer=DISCLAIMER_TR if request.language == Language.TR else DISCLAIMER_EN,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # AI execution
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    async def _run_ai(self, context, warnings: list[str]) -> tuple[AIAnalysis, AIMetadata]:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        provider = self.ai
        meta = AIMetadata(
            provider=getattr(provider, "name", "unknown"),
            model=getattr(provider, "model", None),
            kind=getattr(provider, "kind", "llm"),
            used=False,
            fallback_used=False,
        )

        if isinstance(provider, HeuristicProvider):
            result = await provider.analyze(context)
            meta.used = True
            meta.kind = "deterministic"
            meta.latency_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
            meta.notes = (
                "Deterministik kural motoru kullanıldı."
                if context.language == "tr"
                else "Deterministic rule engine was used."
            )
            if provider.reason:
                meta.notes = f"{meta.notes} {provider.reason}"
            return result, meta

        try:
            result = await provider.analyze(context)
            meta.used = True
            meta.latency_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
            return result, meta
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - we deliberately isolate provider failures
            logger.warning("AI sağlayıcısı başarısız oldu: %s", exc)
            if not self.settings.ai_fallback_to_heuristic:
                raise AnalysisError(
                    f"AI sağlayıcısı yanıt veremedi: {exc}",
                    status_code=503,
                    code="ai_unavailable",
                ) from exc

            result = await self.heuristic.analyze(context)
            meta.used = False
            meta.fallback_used = True
            meta.error = str(exc)[:500]
            meta.latency_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
            meta.notes = (
                "LLM çağrısı başarısız oldu; deterministik motor devreye alındı."
                if context.language == "tr"
                else "LLM call failed; the deterministic engine was used."
            )
            warnings.append(
                "AI sağlayıcısına ulaşılamadı; sonuçlar deterministik agronomi motoruyla üretildi. "
                "AI anahtarını, kotayı ve ağ bağlantısını kontrol edin."
            )
            return result, meta

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Result merging
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _merge(
        self,
        request: AnalyzeRequest,
        environment: EnvironmentSnapshot,
        evaluations: list[CropEvaluation],
        ai_result: AIAnalysis,
        heuristic_result: AIAnalysis,
        ai_meta: AIMetadata,
    ) -> list[CropRecommendation]:
        assessments = {item.crop_key: item for item in ai_result.crops}
        fallback_assessments = {item.crop_key: item for item in heuristic_result.crops}
        weight = self.settings.ai_weight

        merged: list[tuple[float, CropEvaluation, AICropAssessment]] = []
        for evaluation in evaluations:
            assessment = assessments.get(evaluation.crop.key) or fallback_assessments.get(evaluation.crop.key)
            if assessment is None:
                assessment = AICropAssessment(
                    crop_key=evaluation.crop.key,
                    ai_score=evaluation.rule_score,
                    rationale="",
                    risks=evaluation.limiting_factors,
                    actions=[],
                )
            ai_score = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(assessment.ai_score)))
            final_score = (1.0 - weight) * evaluation.rule_score + weight * ai_score
            merged.append((round(final_score, 1), evaluation, assessment))

        merged.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1].crop.market_demand), reverse=True)

        recommendations: list[CropRecommendation] = []
        for rank, (final_score, evaluation, assessment) in enumerate(merged[: request.top_n], start=1):
            crop: CropProfile = evaluation.crop
            confidence = self._confidence(evaluation, ai_result, final_score, merged)
            recommendations.append(
                CropRecommendation(
                    rank=rank,
                    crop_key=crop.key,
                    crop_name=crop.name,
                    crop_name_local=crop.local_name,
                    category=crop.category,
                    scores=ScoreBreakdown(
                        rule_score=evaluation.rule_score,
                        ai_score=round(float(assessment.ai_score), 1),
                        final_score=final_score,
                        components=evaluation.components,
                    ),
                    rationale=assessment.rationale
                    or self._fallback_rationale(evaluation, request.language),
                    risks=self._dedupe(assessment.risks or evaluation.limiting_factors)[:5],
                    actions=self._dedupe(assessment.actions)[:6],
                    planting_window=assessment.planting_window
                    or crop.planting_window(request.language.value),
                    growing_days=crop.growing_days,
                    water_need_mm=crop.water_need_mm,
                    confidence=confidence,
                )
            )
        return recommendations

    @staticmethod
    def _confidence(
        evaluation: CropEvaluation,
        ai_result: AIAnalysis,
        final_score: float,
        merged: list[tuple[float, CropEvaluation, AICropAssessment]],
    ) -> str:
        if ai_result.confidence == "low" or evaluation.confidence == "low":
            return "low"
        gap = final_score - merged[1][0] if len(merged) > 1 else 20.0
        if gap < 4:
            return "low"
        if ai_result.confidence == "high" and evaluation.confidence == "high" and gap >= 8:
            return "high"
        return "medium"

    @staticmethod
    def _fallback_rationale(evaluation: CropEvaluation, language: Language) -> str:
        if language == Language.TR:
            parts = [f"{evaluation.crop.local_name} kural motorunda {evaluation.rule_score}/100 aldı."]
            if evaluation.strengths:
                parts.append("Güçlü yönler: " + "; ".join(evaluation.strengths[:3]) + ".")
            if evaluation.limiting_factors:
                parts.append("Sınırlar: " + "; ".join(evaluation.limiting_factors[:3]) + ".")
            return " ".join(parts)
        parts = [f"{evaluation.crop.name} scored {evaluation.rule_score}/100 in the rule engine."]
        if evaluation.strengths:
            parts.append("Strengths: " + "; ".join(evaluation.strengths[:3]) + ".")
        if evaluation.limiting_factors:
            parts.append("Constraints: " + "; ".join(evaluation.limiting_factors[:3]) + ".")
        return " ".join(parts)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def _dedupe(items: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        seen: set[str] = set()
        output: list[str] = []
        for item in items:
            text = (item or "").strip()
            if text and text not in seen:
                seen.add(text)
                output.append(text)
        return output

    def _data_sources(
        self,
        request: AnalyzeRequest,
        has_daily: bool,
        ai_meta: AIMetadata,
    ) -> list[DataSource]:
        lat = f"{request.location.latitude:.4f}"
        lon = f"{request.location.longitude:.4f}"
        climatology_url = (
            f"{self.settings.nasa_power_base_url}/climatology/point"
            f"?parameters=T2M,T2M_MAX,T2M_MIN,PRECTOTCORR,RH2M,ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN,WS2M,"
            f"GWETROOT,GWETTOP,TS,EVLAND,EVPTRNS&community=AG"
            f"&latitude={lat}&longitude={lon}&format=JSON"
        )
        sources = [
            DataSource(
                name="NASA POWER - Climatology",
                url=climatology_url,
                description="25 yıllık (2001-2025) aylık iklim ve toprak nemi/sıcaklığı ortalamaları.",
            ),
            DataSource(
                name="Çiftçi girdileri",
                url=None,
                description="Tarla profili, kaynaklar ve tercihler; doğrulanmamış beyan niteliğindedir.",
            ),
        ]
        if has_daily:
            daily_url = (
                f"{self.settings.nasa_power_base_url}/daily/point"

                )
            )
        if ai_meta.kind == "llm":

                        f"Model: {ai_meta.model or 'belirtilmedi'}. AI çıktısı doğrulanmamıştır; "

"""FastAPI application factory and system endpoints."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.ai.base import AIProviderError
from app.ai.factory import ai_is_configured, build_ai_provider
from app.api.routes import router
from app.clients.nasa_power import NASAAPIError, NASAPowerClient
from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.logging_conf import configure_logging
from app.schemas import AnalyzeRequest, ApiInfo, HealthResponse
from app.services.recommendation import AnalysisError, RecommendationService

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _example_request() -> dict:
    extra = AnalyzeRequest.model_config.get("json_schema_extra") or {}
    return extra.get("example", {})


def create_app(
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    *,
    nasa_client: NASAPowerClient | None = None,
    ai_provider=None,
) -> FastAPI:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    configure_logging(settings.log_level)

    nasa = nasa_client or NASAPowerClient(
        base_url=settings.nasa_power_base_url,
        community=settings.nasa_power_community,
        timeout_seconds=settings.nasa_power_timeout_seconds,
        cache_ttl_seconds=settings.nasa_power_cache_ttl_seconds,
        daily_cache_ttl_seconds=settings.nasa_power_daily_cache_ttl_seconds,
        max_retries=settings.nasa_power_max_retries,
        retry_backoff_seconds=settings.nasa_power_retry_backoff_seconds,
    )
    ai = ai_provider or build_ai_provider(settings)
    recommender = RecommendationService(nasa, ai, settings)

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
        yield
        for client in (nasa, ai):
            close = getattr(client, "aclose", None)
            if close is not None:
                try:
                    await close()
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - shutdown must not fail
                    logger.warning("İstemci kapatılırken hata oluştu.", exc_info=True)

    app = FastAPI(
        title=settings.app_name,
        version=settings.app_version,
        description=(
            "NASA POWER verileri + açıklanabilir agronomi kuralları + değiştirilebilir LLM "
            "katmanı ile çiftçiler için karar destek API'si. UI ayrı geliştirilecektir; "
            "bu servis JSON API'si ve Swagger arayüzü sunar."
        ),
        lifespan=lifespan,
        docs_url="/docs",
        redoc_url="/redoc",
        openapi_url="/openapi.json",
    )

    app.state.settings = settings
    app.state.nasa = nasa
    app.state.ai = ai
    app.state.recommender = recommender

    origins = settings.cors_origin_list
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=origins,
        allow_credentials=origins != ["*"],
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
        expose_headers=["X-Request-ID", "X-Process-Time-Ms"],
    )

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def request_context(request: Request, call_next):
        request_id = (request.headers.get("X-Request-ID") or uuid4().hex)[:64]
        started = time.perf_counter()
        response = await call_next(request)
        elapsed_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = request_id
        response.headers["X-Process-Time-Ms"] = str(elapsed_ms)
        logger.info(
            "%s %s -> %s (%s ms, request_id=%s)",
            request.method,
            request.url.path,
            response.status_code,
            elapsed_ms,
            request_id,
        )
        return response

    @app.exception_handler(NASAAPIError)
    async def nasa_error_handler(request: Request, exc: NASAAPIError):
        logger.warning("NASA POWER hatası: %s", exc)
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=502,
            content={
                "error": "nasa_power_unavailable",
                "message": str(exc),
                "request_id": getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
            },
        )

    @app.exception_handler(AnalysisError)
    async def analysis_error_handler(request: Request, exc: AnalysisError):
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=exc.status_code,
            content={
                "error": exc.code,
                "message": str(exc),
                "request_id": getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
            },
        )

    @app.exception_handler(AIProviderError)
    async def ai_error_handler(request: Request, exc: AIProviderError):
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=503,
            content={
                "error": "ai_unavailable",
                "message": str(exc),
                "request_id": getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
            },
        )

    @app.get("/", response_model=ApiInfo, tags=["system"])
    async def root() -> ApiInfo:
        return ApiInfo(
            name=settings.app_name,
            version=settings.app_version,
            description=(
                "Çiftçiler için NASA POWER destekli, AI ile zenginleştirilmiş karar destek API'si."
            ),
            docs_url="/docs",
            openapi_url="/openapi.json",
            endpoints={
                "analyze": "POST /api/v1/analyze",
                "environment": "GET /api/v1/environment",
                "crops": "GET /api/v1/crops",
                "ai_providers": "GET /api/v1/ai-providers",
                "health": "GET /health",
            },
            example_request=_example_request(),
        )

    @app.get("/health", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=["system"])
    @app.get("/api/v1/health", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=["system"])
    async def health() -> HealthResponse:
        cache = getattr(nasa, "cache", None)
        return HealthResponse(
            status="ok",
            version=settings.app_version,
            environment=settings.environment,
            ai_provider=getattr(ai, "name", "unknown"),
            ai_configured=ai_is_configured(settings),
            nasa_power_base_url=settings.nasa_power_base_url,
            cache_entries=len(cache) if cache is not None and hasattr(cache, "__len__") else None,
            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )

    app.include_router(router)
    return app


app = create_app()

def _extraterrestrial_radiation_mm_day(latitude: float, month: int) -> float:
    """FAO-56 extraterrestrial radiation (Ra) expressed in mm/day."""

    day_of_year = sum(MONTH_DAYS[: month - 1]) + 15
    phi = math.radians(max(-66.0, min(66.0, latitude)))
    dr = 1.0 + 0.033 * math.cos(2.0 * math.pi * day_of_year / 365.0)
    delta = 0.409 * math.sin(2.0 * math.pi * day_of_year / 365.0 - 1.39)
    x = -math.tan(phi) * math.tan(delta)
    omega = math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, x)))
    ra_mj = (
        (24.0 * 60.0 / math.pi)
        * 0.0820
        * dr
        * (
            omega * math.sin(phi) * math.sin(delta)
            + math.cos(phi) * math.cos(delta) * math.sin(omega)
        )
    )
    return ra_mj * 0.408


def monthly_reference_et0(climatology: NASAResult) -> dict[int, float | None]:
    """Hargreaves-Samani reference evapotranspiration (mm/day) per month.

    NASA POWER exposes actual evaporation/evapotranspiration, which is not a
    valid denominator for an aridity index. Hargreaves is a transparent,
    temperature-based reference ET that can be computed from the climatology.
    """

    t2m = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M")
    tmax = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M_MAX")
    tmin = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M_MIN")
    result: dict[int, float | None] = {}
    for month in range(1, 13):
        mean = t2m[month]
        high = tmax[month]
        low = tmin[month]
        if mean is None or high is None or low is None:
            result[month] = None
            continue
        ra = _extraterrestrial_radiation_mm_day(climatology.latitude, month)
        et0 = 0.0023 * (mean + 17.8) * math.sqrt(max(0.1, high - low)) * ra
        result[month] = max(0.0, et0)
    return result

    t2m = _parameter_by_month(climatology, "T2M")

    }

        for month in range(1, 13)
    }
    annual_evap = _sum(monthly_evap.values())

"""API-level tests (FastAPI + TestClient, external services faked)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from app.ai.base import AIAnalysis, AICropAssessment, AIProvider, AIProviderError
from tests.helpers import FakeNASA, request_payload


def test_health(client):
    response = client.get("/health")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "ok"
    assert data["ai_provider"] == "heuristic"
    assert data["ai_configured"] is True
    assert isinstance(data["cache_entries"], int)
    assert response.headers["X-Request-ID"]


def test_root_describes_api(client):
    response = client.get("/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["docs_url"] == "/docs"
    assert "analyze" in data["endpoints"]
    assert data["example_request"]["location"]["region_name"] == "Ankara"


def test_catalog_and_provider_metadata(client):
    crops = client.get("/api/v1/crops")
    assert crops.status_code == 200
    keys = [item["key"] for item in crops.json()]
    assert len(keys) == len(set(keys))
    assert "wheat" in keys

    providers = client.get("/api/v1/ai-providers")
    assert providers.status_code == 200
    provider_keys = {item["key"] for item in providers.json()}
    assert {"gemini", "openai", "heuristic", "ollama"} <= provider_keys
    recommended = [item for item in providers.json() if item["recommended"]]
    assert len(recommended) == 1


def test_analyze_success(client):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/analyze", json=request_payload(top_n=3))
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    data = response.json()

    assert data["analysis_id"]
    assert data["location"]["region_name"] == "Ankara"
    assert len(data["environment"]["monthly"]) == 12
    assert len(data["recommendations"]) == 3

    scores = [item["scores"]["final_score"] for item in data["recommendations"]]
    assert scores == sorted(scores, reverse=True)
    assert [item["rank"] for item in data["recommendations"]] == [1, 2, 3]
    assert data["recommendations"][0]["crop_key"] == "wheat"
    assert data["ai"]["kind"] == "deterministic"
    assert data["ai"]["used"] is True
    assert data["summary"]
    assert data["disclaimer"]
    assert data["data_sources"]
    assert "detay" not in data["recommendations"][0]


def test_analyze_validation_error(client):
    payload = request_payload()
    payload["location"]["latitude"] = 120
    response = client.post("/api/v1/analyze", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 422

    assert response.status_code == 502
    body = response.json()
    assert body["error"] == "nasa_power_unavailable"
    assert "maintenance" in body["message"]

    assert response.status_code == 422

        recent_days=30,
